text_to_image_prompt: Adult elegant woman, short blonde side-parted bob, blue-gray eyes, pearl drop earrings, black square-neck tailored sheath dress with three-quarter sleeves and below-knee hem, black pumps. Single frontal eye-level head-and-shoulder portrait, neutral expression. Pure white seamless studio background, soft even daylight, natural detailed skin and individual hair strands, accurate cloth weave and shoe leather, realistic photography, no text, no watermark. Maintain natural adult anatomy and consistent identity.
original_prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Edit the supplied approved casting sheet by extracting ONLY the specified actor into one standalone photorealistic head-and-upper-torso identity portrait. This is the EXACT SAME approved person, not recasting. Preserve their precise facial anatomy, eye shape/color, age, hairline, haircut/color, skin tone, characteristic features, clothing and accessories. Change only the pose/camera and background: strict front view, camera exactly at eye level, zero head yaw/pitch/roll, eyes level and directly facing the lens, head upright, shoulders level and square to camera. Neutral relaxed expression retaining natural character. Even soft frontal daylight, natural detailed skin, no beautification, no de-aging, no CGI. Flat PURE WHITE #FFFFFF background edge-to-edge, no gray, no beige, no gradient, no vignette, no shadows on the backdrop. Single person centered, whole hair/head visible with white margin above, upper torso to mid chest, portrait 3:4 composition. No hands, text, labels, borders, other faces or panels. Do not borrow any feature from any other person in the sheet. Target ONLY cell 04, TOP ROW FOURTH COLUMN: adult woman with chin-length side-parted blonde bob, gray-blue eyes, deep rose lips, pearl drop earrings and black square-neck dress. Preserve the exact approved face and mature age appearance. Correct the original slight head tilt so face and shoulders are straight, front-facing and level.
